profile.headline: Sr. Software Engineer
profile.summary: A highly ambitious software/systems engineer/tech lead with 20+ years experience in software development, systems integration, network engineering, cyber security, civil/military air space command and control systems worldwide.

positions.title: Sr. Embedded Software Engineer
positions.description:
- I get shit done …
- Sr. Embedded Ada Software Developer
- Integration Team/Lead
- Collaborate with Systems, Software, Simulation, Test Team, and Management to solve system issues.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer - Space Systems
positions.description:
- Sr. Principal Ada Monkey - Modeling and Simulation team for Missile Defense System
- Used tactical software to develop a new baseline for current and future SIM software for GMD
- This was key for getting SIM current and building a solid foundation for the future

positions.title: Software Project Director - Software Development Lead
positions.description:
- US Army Futures Command - Night Vision Modeling and Simulation Division – Ft. Belvoir, VA
- Program Management
- Risk Management Framework (RMF)  
- Jira, Jira Portfolio Project Management

positions.title: Sr Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Sr Ada/C engineer on Battle Control System program
- Key developer of ProCon – Sensor Protocol Converter Program for converting sensor/data link messages into single common message formats. 100+ protocols supported, 1000+ channels of data
- Network software engineering
- Build manager

positions.title: Air Traffic Control Systems - ACC/APP/TWR .. Systems .. Software .. Integration
positions.description:
- Systems Integrator/SW Developer/Project Management/7-24-365 Warranty Support/On-Site Worldwide
- SEA Region Manager for the DFS (Deutsche Flugsicherung), providing installation, software development, and warranty support for the PHOENIX ATM (Air Traffic Management) APP/TWR systems installed worldwide. 
- Raytheon ATC System troubleshooting and fixing service..
- ATC SW Development, Trade Show Booth Bunny.
- Adapted systems to customer requirements, ran formal tests, wrote documentation, installed/integrated systems (HW & SW) on site and sold off several DFS PHOENIX ATC Systems in Kazakhstan, Azerbaijan, and Thailand.
- Designed and developed the AFTN working position using C/C++, QT3 & 4 on a Linux platform, allowing the PHOENIX system to receive, process and send AFTN messages, decode and correlate flight plans to tracks, processing all AFTN messages required by ICAO 4444 including routes.
- Sold 2 PHOENIX ATM systems to the Royal Thai Air Force. Did several high level technical presentations of the system to RTAF officers up to 3 Star rank. Adapted, installed, sold off and provided in country warranty support for the 3 years warranty period for each system.
